data.name: Fliet Pizza Delivery
data.description:
u'
Bringing Pizza to a battlefield near you.

There aren\u2019t many rules, but they can all be summed up by \u201cDon\u2019t be a Dick\u201d. We\'re all about having fun, and have no tolerance for toxic language/behaviour including racism, sexism, homophobia etc. We aren\u2019t precious about our killboard but if you\u2019re out there losing blingy ships in dumb ways, expect someone to tap you on the shoulder and check in to see if there\u2019s some way we can help out.

Rundown:
* Specialize in Gallente Faction Warfare plex gameplay
* Solo/small-gang
* Heavy focus on flying Gallente ships
* We honor requested 1v1
* EVE online tournament: AT XVIII, XIX, and Captain\'s Cup
* Killing blues will get you kicked (AWOX not tolerated)
* NO SKILL REQUIREMENTS!
* Billions in corp projects for FW actions

We are strongest in USTZ, but fleet availability varies a lot based on warzone activity, timezones and peoples real life schedules. We work closely with the wider Galmil community, but be prepared for periods of solo/small gang fighting, and keep your ears out for any larger GalMil fleets/pings. We usually use GalMil Discord for comms as we work in with a variety of corps. We\u2019re new bro friendly so don\u2019t hesitate to ask questions and make mistakes.

We operate out of GalMil discord exclusively https://discord.gg/galmil
FPD discord is only used for interview process https://discord.gg/nF3Mwabtpq

FPD has a 2 month inactive purge
Top 100 all time kills are safe from purge (only 70+ kills)

NOTE
microphone is required
background change is optional to be accepted to corp'
